tagging.why: Cheapest model that accepts a contact sheet and the voiceover audio in one call.

planning.why: Tool calling and judgement for shot selection and the refine chat.

review.why: Native video input for scoring the rendered draft.

music.why: Music beds for the bank; generated once, reused with cached beat grids.

tts.why: Optional voice replacement when the realtor's take cannot be rescued.

tagging.why: High-volume contact sheets. Cheapest provider wins; quality is gated by the bake-off before this is trusted.

planning.why: Interactive: the user is waiting on a plan or a chat reply. Throughput beats a few tenths of a cent.

review.why: Runs unattended in the background; let OpenRouter pick the healthy provider.

music.why: Metered per track, not per token.

tts.why: Only used when a voiceover must be replaced.

caching.policy: System instructions, JSON schema and style guide go first and never change between calls in a stage; variable content (contact sheet, shot table, user request) goes last. Anthropic models get an explicit ephemeral cache_control breakpoint; Gemini and OpenAI cache long stable prefixes implicitly.
caching.measure: Record usage.prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens and usage.cache_discount on every call; net cost = estimate - cache_discount.

upscaling.note: Opt-in, per file, priced before it runs. Never part of a batch.
